enemy.en: All of a sudden, the enemy bombs came down on us like rain.
enemy.zh: 突然，敌人的炸弹像雨点一样落向我们。

escape.en: He looked for every possible means of escape.
escape.zh: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。

error.en: "There's an apostrophe missing. It's and its are different." "I know. It was a typing error."
error.zh: “你漏写了一个撇号。it's和its是有分别的。” “我知道。是我打错了。”

exist.en: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
exist.zh: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。

easily.en: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
easily.zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

extremely.en: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
extremely.zh: 变量的声明在C和C++中极其重要。

exception.en: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
exception.zh: 这个月一直都很热，但今天是个例外。

eagle.en: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
eagle.zh: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

eyesight.en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
eyesight.zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。

energy.en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
energy.zh: 问题是, 太阳能太贵了。

envy.en: I envy the friendship Tom and Mary have.

event.en: On the whole, the event was successful.
event.zh: 整体而言，这个事件是成功的。

edge.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
edge.zh: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。

elderly.en: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
elderly.zh: 我们移走了行李腾出空间让老太太可以坐下。

engine.en: Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.
engine.zh: 让引擎持续运转，我去去就来。

evidence.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
evidence.zh: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。

elevator.en: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
elevator.zh: 我到柜台拿了钥匙，然后就乘电梯去了我房间的楼层。

explain.en: Tom doesn't quite get it. Could you explain it to him again?
explain.zh: 汤姆不大明白。你能再跟他解释一遍吗？

electricity.en: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
electricity.zh: 澳大利亚在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

express.en: I'd like to know the phone number of the nearest American Express office.
express.zh: 我想知道最近的美国运通办事处的电话号码。

eager.en: When we are told not to come, we become all the more eager to go.
eager.zh: 让我们别来，我们就更想来了。

eighty.en: Eighty percent of all information on computers around the world is in English.
eighty.zh: 全世界百分之八十电脑上的资讯都是用英语写的。

eve.en: I'm spending Christmas Eve with my family.

entrance.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
entrance.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！

essay.en: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
essay.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

extra.en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
extra.zh: 我太太兼职的工作赚进了一些额外的钱。

education.en: He always left the problem of his children's education to his wife.
education.zh: 他总是把孩子的教育问题留给他的妻子。

enthusiasm.zh: 汤姆没有感受到玛丽的热情。

envelope.en: Tom told me not to open the envelope until my birthday.
envelope.zh: 汤姆告诉我，到我生日那天我才能打开信封。

excellent.en: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
excellent.zh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。

exciting.en: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?
exciting.zh: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？

enter.en: People who drink alcoholic beverages are not allowed to enter.

exactly.en: Tom didn't know exactly what it was that Mary wanted him to do.
exactly.zh: 汤姆不知道玛丽到底让他做什么。

equal.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.

entire.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
entire.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

economy.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
economy.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

exchange.en: The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.

endure.en: Can she endure a long trip?

expert.en: Even expert drivers can make mistakes.
expert.zh: 再怎么经验老到的司机都会出错。

especially.en: I like to listen to music, especially jazz.
especially.zh: 我喜欢听音乐，特别是爵士音乐。

expression.zh: 那种表达方式已经过时了。

election.en: "What do you think of the election for mayor?" "I don't know."
election.zh: “你对市长选举怎么看？”“我不知道。”

exhibition.en: Did you go to the art exhibition?

essential.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
essential.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。

execute.zh: 我们必须执行他的命令。

elephant.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
elephant.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

experience.en: We're looking for someone who has experience in customer service.
experience.zh: 我们正在寻找具有客服工作经验的人。

exact.en: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
exact.zh: 你能否说出这个词的精确意思?

explanation.en: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
explanation.zh: 这个解释不是很令人满意。

engineer.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
engineer.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。

englishman.en: He mistook me for an Englishman.
englishman.zh: 他误认为我是一个英国人。

executive.en: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
executive.zh: 我们需要人力仲介公司帮我们找到合适的人来担任这个管理职位。

evil.en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
evil.zh: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

experiment.en: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
experiment.zh: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。

electrical.en: Keep away from the electrical equipment.

embassy.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
embassy.zh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。

emergency.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
emergency.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

embarrass.en: I didn't mean to embarrass you.

emotional.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
emotional.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

environmental.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
environmental.zh: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。

electric.en: I should have tried out this electric shaver before buying it.
electric.zh: 我本该在买下这个电动剃须刀之前试一下的。

editor.en: You don't want to be an editor?

extreme.en: Your proposal is a bit extreme.

eclipse.en: Did you see the eclipse yesterday?
eclipse.zh: 你看了昨天的月蚀了吗？

earn.en: Money takes a long time to earn, but you can spend it in no time.
earn.zh: 钱要花很长的时间来赚, 但你可以一下子就花掉它了。

extent.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.
extent.zh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。

explode.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

ease.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
ease.zh: 我面对陌生人很不自在。

earthquake.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
earthquake.zh: 一些航班由于地震被延误了。

examination.en: The student handed the examination papers in to the teacher.
examination.zh: 该学生把考试卷交给了老师。

eligible.en: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.
eligible.zh: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。

employment.en: They guaranteed regular employment to their workers.
employment.zh: 他们对他们的员工保证就业。

engagement.en: He announced his engagement to her.

extension.en: This extension cord is too short.

effort.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
effort.zh: 已经花费了很多的时间和精力。

external.en: Save it on the external hard drive.
external.zh: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。

economical.en: London was very important for economical and cultural reasons.
economical.zh: 伦敦过去因为经济和文化的缘故，十分重要。

explosion.en: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.
explosion.zh: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。

eloquent.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
eloquent.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

equipment.en: Keep away from the electrical equipment.

envious.en: She was envious of her cousin's success.

ecology.en: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
ecology.zh: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。

ending.en: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
ending.zh: 我不想把结局提前透露给你。

evident.en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
evident.zh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

elementary.en: They became friends in elementary school.
elementary.zh: 他们在小学时就是朋友了。

existence.en: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?

examine.en: Dentists take X-rays to examine your teeth.
examine.zh: 牙医用X光检查你的牙齿。

eternal.en: Do you believe in eternal life after death?

equality.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

engineering.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
engineering.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？

everyday.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.
everyday.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。

expedition.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
expedition.zh: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。

economic.en: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
economic.zh: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

emphasize.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

employee.en: She's not a full-time employee of this company.
employee.zh: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。

emotion.en: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
emotion.zh: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

exhaust.en: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.
exhaust.zh: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。

extinct.en: Dinosaurs became extinct a very long time ago.
extinct.zh: 恐龙在很久以前灭绝了。

establish.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
establish.zh: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。

elaborate.en: She made elaborate preparations for the party.
elaborate.zh: 她精心筹备了这个派对。

effect.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
effect.zh: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。

efficient.en: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
efficient.zh: 无可否认她非常有能力。

effective.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
effective.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

emperor.en: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.

emphasis.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
emphasis.zh: 他强调了教育的重要性。

extend.en: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.
extend.zh: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。

eighteen.en: I learned to drive a car and got a driver's license when I was eighteen.
eighteen.zh: 我十八岁时，学了开车、考到了驾照。

equator.en: I crossed the equator for the first time on my trip to Australia.
equator.zh: 我去澳大利亚旅游的时候第一次穿越了赤道。

execution.en: A stay of execution was ordered at the eleventh hour.
execution.zh: 缓期执行在最后关头决定了下来。

exaggerate.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
exaggerate.zh: 在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。

estimate.en: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?
estimate.zh: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？

exquisite.en: The tourists were fascinated with the exquisite scenery.
exquisite.zh: 观光客被独特的景致所吸引。

ethical.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
ethical.zh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

endeavour.en: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
endeavour.zh: 我们会尽力在这礼拜结束前把工作完成。

equivalent.en: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
equivalent.zh: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

evacuate.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
evacuate.zh: 我们有不到五分钟来疏散整栋楼的人。

ethics.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
ethics.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

empire.en: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
empire.zh: 纽约帝国大厦现在完全依靠风力发电。

electronic.en: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
electronic.zh: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

elliptical.en: Since the orbits are elliptical, the planets do not always have the same distance from the Sun.
elliptical.zh: 由于轨道是椭圆形的，行星和太阳之间的距离不会总是相同。

extinction.en: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.
extinction.zh: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。
